segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report calming, hydrating, non-irritating results (including on rosacea-like and perioral dermatitis-affected skin), while others describe itching and small-bump breakouts that worsened with continued use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most often report increased hydration, plumping, and a glowy, dewy finish, with a few noting the effect faded within hours or left skin feeling sticky.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, oil- and acne-prone skin reports the serum absorbed without feeling oily or tacky.
segments.mature: Reviewers in perimenopause or noting fine lines/stress lines report smoother, firmer-feeling skin and some perceived softening of lines, though one is unsure the effect justifies repurchase.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report reduced appearance of fine lines, wrinkles, or stress lines and a more youthful, elastic feel; one reviewer with only a small sample could not confirm the claimed 4-week fine-line effect.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report immediate and lasting hydration, plumping, and a dewy glow, including on skin described as very dry; a couple say the hydrating effect did not last past a few hours.
concerns.redness: Reviewers describe fading of red marks and calming of rosacea-like redness and perioral dermatitis-affected skin over repeated use, with soothing felt from the first applications.
concerns.barrier: One long-term user reports the serum helped strengthen and heal skin affected by perioral dermatitis when used on controlled (not actively flaring) areas; another reports repair of skin damaged by over-exfoliation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with pregnancy-related hormonal acne reports it healed acne scars and small wrinkles; one sensitive-skin reviewer reports small bumps and breakouts appearing with use, worsening the longer it was applied.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers report no new breakouts and clearer-looking skin within days; one sensitive-skin reviewer reports breaking out in small itchy bumps.
concerns.oiliness: One combination/oily-skin reviewer reports the serum did not feel oily or tacky after absorption; no reviewer reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Samples too small to judge long-term results

extraits.texte: I bought this stuff on a whim, having tried the original Mineral 89 serum and liking it. I didn't expect much, but after a couple of applications it was clear this serum would be my ticket - finally - out of perioral dermatitis land (which, turns out, is actually just h*ll). I'd tried everything: antibiotics, special creams and ointments, all the supposed PD remedies on social media, and obviously abstaining from all fun skin care and make up – for literally 3 years. I found products that didn't hurt (like the original Mineral 89) but nothing that helped. This stuff actually helps. I can put it directly on my affected skin, it feels soothing and hydrating. I go to bed with it on and in the morning my affected skin looks and feels stronger and healthier. I've been using it for about 3 weeks and am now at a point where I can put a little bit of make up on my trouble spots without the tiny pustules appearing. I should say: I haven't tried it on a flareup, as I havent had one in a while, so I can't speak to its ability to help with that. But as far as putting it on PD areas that are under control, and strengthening the skin barrier in those areas so that the PD can actually go away - 10/10 endorsement from me. If I could meet the Frenchies who created this serum I'd give them a blubbery tearful hug and they'd think I was a lunatic. But people with stubborn cases of PD get it.
